neighbours.label: 'However' (and caveat 'but') as a contrast marker that introduces a caveat after a positive statement
fire: The hotel offers free parking for guests. However, spaces fill up quickly in summer.
Our app works offline in most cases. However, syncing needs a connection.
The recipe is easy to follow. However, the dough must rest overnight.
Shipping is usually free within the country. However, islands may cost extra.
The trail is well marked. However, it gets muddy after heavy rain.
We checked every figure carefully. However, we cannot guarantee their accuracy.
The museum is open daily. However, some rooms close on Mondays.
The drug lowers blood pressure in most patients. However, it may cause dizziness.
quiet: The hotel offers free parking for guests. Also, there is a shuttle to the beach.
Our app works offline in most cases. Moreover, it syncs automatically later.
The recipe is easy to follow. Afterwards, the dough can be frozen for weeks.
Shipping is usually free within the country. Returns are free as well.
The trail is well marked. Benches line the route every mile.
We checked every figure carefully. Then we sent the report to the board.
The museum is open daily. Guided tours start every hour.
The drug lowers blood pressure in most patients. It is taken once a day.

notes: Card: ' However' x19, 'However' x5, ' however' x4, ' but' x4 of the top 32. The + pole is additive 'but also/while still', the other side of the contrast distinction.
